raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Silver keeps every POSTED row, but 15 REVERSAL rows in raw_transactions point at original transactions (via orig_txn_id) that remain POSTED, so the reversed amounts are counted in gold. Excluding the originals named by REVERSAL rows, and the REVERSAL rows themselves, should bring gold totals back in line with the settlement file.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED' AND CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) NOT IN (SELECT CAST(orig_txn_id AS BIGINT) FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'REVERSAL' AND orig_txn_id IS NOT NULL);"}}
